title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Role/person, organization, business decision, metric owned, workshop role, accountable task, contact/access permission, escalation

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Support leader owns outcome; frontline user explains workflow; platform owner validates data; sponsor decides priority.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Every critical decision and follow-up has one accountable owner and a backup.
